Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Angled Stoneware Home Decor Flower Vase - 12 Inch, White
Neutral white with angled patterns allow it to blend with any room 100% stoneware with transparent glaze 5.9"Diameter x 11.9" H Durable stoneware vase great for display or holding flowers. Folds and angles bring a chic design to this contemporary stoneware vase. The lovely milky white color with transparent glaze will go with any décor. Add flowers if you wish, but this vase can also stand alone as a decorative piece.
